traits.name: Shielded Mind
traits.text: The couatl’s thoughts can’t be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the couatl’s next turn.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature the couatl can see within 5 feet.

actions.name: Failure
actions.text: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
